LanguageData.GR_JaffaPrimtaCeremony_CommandDescriptio: Choose one nearby eligible Jaffa. A physical Prim'ta larva must remain close to the ritual basin until the timed ceremony is complete. The larva is consumed and implanted without using the medical-operation bill.
LanguageData.GR_JaffaPrimtaCeremony_CancelCommandDesc: Cancel the current formal Jaffa Prim'ta ceremony before completion.
LanguageData.GR_JaffaPrimtaCeremony_NoLarvaNearby: A physical Prim'ta larva must be placed near the ritual basin.
LanguageData.GR_JaffaPrimtaCeremony_NoTargetNearby: No eligible Jaffa is available near the ritual basin.
LanguageData.GR_JaffaPrimtaCeremony_InvalidTarget: This pawn is not an eligible nearby Jaffa for the formal Prim'ta ceremony.
LanguageData.GR_JaffaPrimtaCeremony_StartFailed: The formal Prim'ta ceremony could not be started. Check the target and nearby larva.
LanguageData.GR_JaffaPrimtaCeremony_Started: {0}'s formal Prim'ta ceremony has begun. Keep the Jaffa and larva near the basin for {1} ticks.
LanguageData.GR_JaffaPrimtaCeremony_CancelledManual: The formal Prim'ta ceremony has been cancelled.
LanguageData.GR_JaffaPrimtaCeremony_CancelledInvalid: The formal Prim'ta ceremony was interrupted because the target, basin or larva became unavailable or moved out of range.
LanguageData.GR_JaffaPrimtaCeremony_Success: {0} has received a Prim'ta during a formal ceremony.
